title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky

info.about: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky, also known as Trails in the Sky FC, is a 2004 role-playing video game developed by Nihon Falcom. The game is the first in the Trails series, itself a part of the larger The Legend of Heroes series.
info.trivia: The series' first Western release, in 2011; a full remake followed in 2025.
info.why: XSEED printed few copies of a very long RPG for a shrinking system, and the 2025 remake drove new interest in where the series began.
